text: thats good i would not enforce that it has to be a automatic write to the file, and in fact i would make it clear that one has changes than the other,  ensuring the on-disk form is the source of truth, thus meaning a formal confirmation to update the on disk file when a change is made
resolution: Reworked the World Knowledge authoring proposal around canonical Markdown block files and an explicitly divergent editor draft. The design now specifies visible DISK, DRAFT CHANGED, DISK CHANGED, and CONFLICT states; semantic and exact-text review; named target paths; formal Write to Disk confirmation; expected-hash conflict detection; atomic byte-preserving patches; noncanonical crash recovery; and disk-only normal compilation.
